name: t0013_changed_package.py
text:
"""Package completed immutable branch receipts as an English report; never rerun measurement/audit."""
import ast, hashlib, json, math
from pathlib import Path
R=Path.cwd(); O=R/'build/t0013_changed'; P=R/'bots/p_only/report/p_features/changed_reply'; W=R.parents[1]
def read(p):return json.loads(Path(p).read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
def sha(p):return hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def save(p,d):Path(p).write_text(json.dumps(d,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
plan=read(O/'PLAN.json');stats=read(O/'RESULTS.json');audit=read(O/'INDEPENDENT_AUDIT.json');complete=read(O/'AUDIT_COMPLETE.json');preflight=read(O/'PREFLIGHT.json')
assert complete['success'] and audit['pass'] and complete['identity']==plan['identity']==stats['identity']==audit['identity']
assert sha(O/'RESULTS.json')==complete['results_sha256'] and sha(O/'INDEPENDENT_AUDIT.json')==complete['audit_sha256']
assert audit['physical_continuations']==2898 and audit['turn_blocks']==1159200
assert sum(stats['groups']['near']['root_sign_counts'].values())==465
assert sum(stats['groups']['far']['root_sign_counts'].values())==20
by={x['key']:x for x in preflight['roots']}
provenance={}
for group in ['near','far']:
 pairs=[x for x in plan['pairs'] if x['group']==group]
 provenance[group]={'A_equals_recorded_root_reply':sum(x['a_equals_recorded'] for x in pairs),
 'A_differs_from_recorded_root_reply':sum(not x['a_equals_recorded'] for x in pairs),
 'same_one_step_public_successor':sum(by[x['root_key']]['next_block_sha256'][x['a']]==by[x['root_key']]['next_block_sha256'][x['b']] for x in pairs)}
prefix_denom=sum(3*len(x['candidates'])*(x['turn']-1)*x['teams'] for x in plan['roots'])
near=stats['groups']['near'];far=stats['groups']['far'];ns=near['root_sign_counts'];fs=far['root_sign_counts'];rd=near['repeat_diagnostics'];ci=near['ci95']
text=f'''# C08 changed-reply counterfactual

Generated by `t0013_changed_package.py` from the completed frozen plan, full raw audit and statistics. No games, continuations, native replay, scoring or audit were repeated during packaging.

## Result

The 465 near-swap changed replies do not show a conditional mean utility improvement over their P2 alternatives. The count-equally-weighted P3-minus-P2 delta is **{near['equal_count_delta']:+.6f}**, with stratified map-clustered 95% interval **[{ci[0]:+.6f}, {ci[1]:+.6f}]**. This interval includes zero.

| Cohort | Pairs | Counts / maps | Count-equal delta | Map-clustered 95% interval | Estimated positive / negative / zero roots |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---|---|
| Near (primary) | 465 | 13 / 26 | {near['equal_count_delta']:+.6f} | [{ci[0]:+.6f}, {ci[1]:+.6f}] | {ns['positive']} / {ns['negative']} / {ns['zero']} |
| Far (secondary) | 20 | 9 / 12 | {far['equal_count_delta']:+.6f} | Unavailable: six singleton-map count strata | {fs['positive']} / {fs['negative']} / {fs['zero']} |

Root signs are signs of differences between three-repeat sample means, not adjudications of the true better action. Positive/negative frequencies and the count-equal mean have different weighting and magnitude information. The unweighted-root mean is {near['root_weighted_delta_context']:+.6f} for near and {far['root_weighted_delta_context']:+.6f} for far; neither replaces the primary statistic.

Near covers counts 3–15, two source maps per count. The 20 far roots cover nine counts and 12 maps; six counts have only one changed-root map, so a fixed-count within-map uncertainty interval cannot be established for that cohort. Far is separate and coverage-limited. Two near/far pairs have identical A/B orders and reuse the same verified repeat receipts: 485 statistical pairs comprise 483 unique root states and 2,898 unique physical continuations. No root was added or excluded to change the outcome.

## Intervention and continuation policy

A is the saved fixed-128, deadline-off P2 diagnostic reply. It matches the original timed recorded root reply at {provenance['near']['A_equals_recorded_root_reply']}/465 near roots and {provenance['far']['A_equals_recorded_root_reply']}/20 far roots; it is not universally the recorded on-policy action. B is the near/far branch-only P3 diagnostic reply, with the root P2 model unchanged. This is not full deployed-P3 versus P2 continuation.

Both alternatives use the exact same frozen deployed C08 P2/V-off binary from t+1 onward, with original opponents live and reactive. Fresh bots receive the complete recorded input prefix. The engine uses recorded orders through t-1; opponents' t replies are common and recorded, while our complete t reply is forced to A or B. All seats are live afterward through turn 400. The stock branch protocol retains bot memory of its computed root choice rather than the forced action; this limitation applies to both candidates. Two near pairs have identical one-step public successors under recorded opponents and are retained; this check is not exhaustive canonical-action equivalence.

Master 20261260 binds scheduling and candidate/repeat order. Original map and flag seeds are retained to reproduce the root and subsequent engine stream. These are three runtime/strategy repeats, not independent flag-seed replications or fresh independent maps. No variance of 0.15 was assumed.

## Repeat variation and replay diagnostics

Near: {rd['actions_with_three_equal_outcomes']}/{rd['all_action_sets']} candidate sets have three identical final utilities; {rd['all_action_sets']-rd['actions_with_three_equal_outcomes']} vary. Mean within-action sample variance is {rd['mean_A_sample_variance']:.8f} for A and {rd['mean_B_sample_variance']:.8f} for B. Mean sample variance of paired repeat differences is {rd['mean_paired_repeat_sample_variance']:.8f}. Repeats share the original engine flag stream; these descriptive variances do not establish IID noise.

There are {audit['prefix_reply_mismatches']:,} computed-versus-recorded prefix reply mismatches across {prefix_denom:,} prefix-seat comparisons. Recorded engine prefixes remain exact because computed prefix replies are discarded. Mismatches measure replay/history/runtime divergence and are not removed from the utility denominator.

## Validation and interpretation

The collection completed all 2,898 continuations. Independent audit re-stepped all {audit['turn_blocks']:,} TURN blocks and checked the recorded prefix, root, forced own order, common opponent root orders, live used orders, final score vectors, utility, raw receipts and source/binary/engine/limits identities. All-phase faults: {audit['all_phase_faults']}; prefix {audit['prefix_faults']}, discarded computed-root {audit['discarded_root_computed_faults']}, live {audit['live_faults']}. Original 26-stream / 10,400-TURN / all-seat INIT / final-score preflight also passed. Bootstrap vectorized and separate loop arithmetic agree within 1e-14.

The near interval uses 5,000 predeclared percentile bootstrap draws, resampling two maps with replacement within each of 13 counts, retaining all roots of selected maps, then weighting the 13 within-count root means equally. There are 26 source maps, not 465 independent maps. The final fixed-endpoint interval is an ordinary interval; interim peeks were descriptive, no sequential significance procedure was used, and neither the endpoint nor configuration changed. Source selection is from T0013 maps, so this experiment is not independent of that full-game screen.

The evidence supports **advantage not shown** for these changed actions under the common P2 continuation policy. It does not identify deadline tax, saturation or search misuse as the unique mechanism, prove action-level equivalence, approve P3 deployment, or establish an actor route's superiority. No production default, training, export, extra game endpoint or v12 measurement changed.

Frozen measurement identity: `{plan['identity']}`. Full per-count results, per-repeat utilities, bootstrap settings and raw hashes are in [RESULTS.json](RESULTS.json), [INDEPENDENT_AUDIT.json](INDEPENDENT_AUDIT.json), [PLAN.json](PLAN.json) and [PREFLIGHT.json](PREFLIGHT.json). [REPRODUCE.md](REPRODUCE.md) describes source recovery and the completed-run guard.
'''
(P/'RESULTS.md').write_text(text,encoding='utf-8')
(P/'REPRODUCE.md').write_text('''# Reproduce the changed-reply report

The executed report-only host sources are embedded verbatim in EMBEDDED_SOURCES.json (collector and passive helper) and AUDIT_SOURCES.json (independent raw auditor and serial helpers). Verify each embedded SHA before reconstructing a source. PACKAGE_SOURCE.json contains this report formatter, which reads the completed frozen results and does not launch games or audits. Source commit and execution-file hashes are pinned in PLAN.json. The antecedent T13 full screen and P2/P3 swap diagnostic remain completed and immutable.

Ignored build/t0013_changed holds copied exact original match streams, byte-identical frozen binaries/engine, full gzip continuation trajectories and individual successful-run hashes. The raw receipt list in INDEPENDENT_AUDIT.json pins every completed trajectory. FROZEN_AUDIT.json pins the independently executed audit and serial helpers. Completed-run guards reject starting either successful collection or audit again; do not remove completion markers or replay successful slots. Raw bytes, original result JSON, binaries and sources are not changed by publication.

Execution entry points were `python t0013_changed.py prepare`, then `task.py lock --task T0013 --wait 0 cpu -- pwsh ...t0013_changed_run.ps1`. The separately verified finisher waited for the exact collection wrapper birth and successful COMPLETE receipt, then acquired a new exclusive CPU lease for `t0013_changed_audit_run.ps1`. Both phases used a hidden helper and a passive 15-second observer. Command/birth/parent/lease receipts remain local because they contain private host paths. No formal GPU work shared the host lease.

For a fresh independent reproduction, provide the exact antecedent raw streams and binaries, preserve map/flag seeds to reproduce these roots, select a new unused scheduling master, and create a new measurement identity/output directory. This is a new measurement, not a repair or restart of the completed one. No promise of identical timed bot replies is made. Preserve computed-prefix mismatches, forced-action bot-memory limitations and every fault.

Initial serial helper v1 exited before any audit: JSON had already decoded birth timestamps to datetime; reparsing their culture string lost subsecond precision. v2 retained datetime ticks directly and was verified against CIM. The failed script, binding and logs are retained locally under failed_finisher_v1. Collection sources, recipe and binaries were never changed or restarted. SOURCE_BINDING.json records exact original manifest/input/binary checks and the CRLF-to-LF reconstruction of the retained bundle; no binary was rebuilt.
''',encoding='utf-8')
checks={'measurement_identity':plan['identity'],'completed_collection_sha256':sha(O/'COMPLETE.json'),'completed_audit_sha256':sha(O/'AUDIT_COMPLETE.json'),
 'original_results_sha256':sha(O/'RESULTS.json'),'original_raw_audit_sha256':sha(O/'INDEPENDENT_AUDIT.json'),
 'packager_sha256':sha(__file__),'root_reply_provenance':provenance,'prefix_seat_comparisons':prefix_denom,
 'scope':'Completed independent raw/engine/statistics audit; publication validation is separate. No successful formal phase repeated.',
 'original_core_suite_context':'T13 prior core224:223 pass,1 platform skip. Production sources unchanged; prior completed core/measurement checks not rerun.'}
save(P/'CHECKS.json',checks)
save(P/'PACKAGE_SOURCE.json',{'name':Path(__file__).name,'sha256':sha(__file__),'text':Path(__file__).read_bytes().decode('utf-8')})
for fn,binding in [('EMBEDDED_SOURCES.json',plan['helper_sources']),('AUDIT_SOURCES.json',read(P/'FROZEN_AUDIT.json')['sources'])]:
 entries=read(P/fn)
 for name,entry in entries.items():
  source=W/name
  assert sha(source)==binding[name]==entry['sha256']
  entry['text']=source.read_bytes().decode('utf-8')
 save(P/fn,entries)
for p in P.glob('*.json'):json.loads(p.read_text())
for fn in ['EMBEDDED_SOURCES.json','AUDIT_SOURCES.json']:
 for name,entry in read(P/fn).items():
  b=entry['text'].encode();assert hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()==entry['sha256']
  if name.endswith('.py'):ast.parse(entry['text'])
print(json.dumps({'packaged':True,'files':len(list(P.iterdir())),'identity':plan['identity'],'near_delta':near['equal_count_delta'],'near_ci':ci,'root_provenance':provenance}))
